versions.content: In case application allows to clear the DTC, the Dcm module shall check if the DTC can be cleared in the current mode condition (according to the configuration parameter DcmDspClearDTCModeRuleRef ). If not, the Dcm module shall send the calculated negative response code of the referenced DcmModeRule .
